description: Interpretation guidance for Urban Institute Education Data Portal datasets. The Portal is a curation layer over federal data: lowercase variable names, integer-encoded categoricals, standardized missing codes (-1 missing, -2 not applicable, -3 suppressed). Covers year definitions, grade encoding (grade=-1 is Pre-K, not missing), suppression rates, ODC-By licensing, and cross-source join identifiers. Load before analyzing any Portal data. Routes to source-specific deep-dive skills for individual datasets.
